{{Quote|''Daylight'' ahead, Leia&mdash;! We're ''safe''&mdash;!|[[Zon Zorad]], to [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="ALAWL">"[[As Long As We Live...]]"</ref>}}
'''Ethain''' was the primary [[Star/Legends|star]] of the [[Arda system/Legends|Arda system]],<ref name="Onslaught" /> a part of the [[Back Reach]] area of the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] within the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Ardan Cross]] connected it to the [[Feldwes system/Legends|Feldwes]] and [[Kalishik system/Legends|Kalishik systems]], and another hyperlane linked it to the [[Capella system/Legends|Capella system]].<ref name="TEA" />

Ethain was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Arda I]], [[Arda II]] and [[Arda III]]. The star ejected [[Solar flare/Legends|solar flares]] that affected the nearby planet of Arda I, which was subject to [[Magnetic storm/Legends|geomagnetic storms]] that could generate communications interference.<ref name="Onslaught" />
